name: Generate PRD
description: Produce a Product Requirement Document for an epic from an idea source and supporting material.

inputs.label: Idea Source
inputs.placeholder: A one-line statement of the idea, or a path to the idea source file
inputs.help: The council has no source material without it.

inputs.label: Supporting Material
inputs.placeholder: Paste any relevant text — PRD excerpts, email threads, customer feedback, meeting notes...

inputs.label: Reference Documents
inputs.placeholder: Local file paths or Confluence URLs, one per line

inputs.label: Epic URL (Traceability ID)
inputs.help: Anchors this document in the epic's traceability graph.

inputs.label: Confluence Publish Target
inputs.placeholder: Leave empty to choose at publish time
